== iOS Simulator builds in the app repository

- The app repository now accepts iOS Simulator builds (`.app` bundles). Compress the `.app` bundle to a `.zip` file, then upload it from the app repository, API v2, or the Kobiton CLI. A `.app` file that is a `.zip` archive is also accepted.
- Simulator apps show the Apple watermark and support the same app repository actions as other iOS apps, including search, versioning, download, and removal.
- If you select an uncompressed `.app` in the app repository, a message asks you to compress it first.
